items.title: Polen - Hunderte bei Gedenkmesse für Opfer von Anschlag in Krakau
items.teaser: In der polnischen Stadt Krakau haben viele hundert Menschen bei einem Gedenkgottesdienst der Opfer des mutmaßlich rechtsextremen Anschlags gedacht.

items.title: Power to Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant cut, restored, IAEA says
items.teaser: The plant lost connection to its sole 330-kilovolt (kV) external power line, forcing it to rely on emergency diesel generators for cooling and safety functions, the IAEA announced around noon local time. 10 hours later, the IAEA confirmed power had been restored.

items.title: Average age of mobilized recruits joining Ukraine’s Air Assault forces is 35–44
items.teaser: The average age of mobilized personnel joining the Ukrainian Air Assault Forces is currently 35–44.

items.title: Ukraine’s Air Assault Forces adapt Western combat tactics and training methods to battlefield needs
items.teaser: The training of servicemen in the Ukrainian Air Assault Forces incorporates practices adopted from partner countries, particularly tactics for combat in urban and wooded areas and methods of instruction.

items.title: Untersuchung gegen Nvidia-Chef Huang wegen möglicher Spionin aus China
items.teaser: Der KI-Chip-Gigant Nvidia hat nach Berichten über einen Spionageverdacht eine Untersuchung gegen seinen Gründer und Konzernchef Jensen Huang eingeleitet. Er soll eine Affäre mit einer mutmaßlichen chinesischen Spionin gehabt haben. Von Gabi Biesinger.

items.title: Another stage of search operations completed in Puzhnyky, no mass grave found
items.teaser: A team of Ukrainian and Polish specialists has completed another stage of searches for the remains of people killed during World War II in the former village of Puzhnyky in the Ternopil region.

items.title: Aktuelles zum Krieg in der Ukraine
items.teaser: Seit Februar 2022 führt Russland einen Angriffskrieg gegen die Ukraine, die Kämpfe dauern an. Alle Entwicklungen und Ukraine-News im Liveticker.

items.title: Air Assault Forces most in need of riflemen
items.teaser: The greatest personnel shortage in the Ukrainian Air Assault Forces is currently among riflemen.

items.title: Chip-Hersteller - Nvidia startet Untersuchung zu möglicher Spionage bei Firmenchef Huang
items.teaser: Der US-Chip-Hersteller Nvidia hat eine Untersuchung zu Berichten eingeleitet, nach denen Firmenchef Huang zum Ziel ausländischer Spionageaktivitäten geworden ist.

items.title: War update: 127 clashes on front line, Pokrovsk sector remains hottest
items.teaser: A total of 127 combat engagements took place on the front line, with Russian forces losing more than 60 personnel in the Pokrovsk sector.

items.title: Power outage schedules to be in effect in some Ukrainian regions on Monday
items.teaser: Electricity consumption restrictions will be in effect in some regions of Ukraine on Monday, November 9.

items.title: Injury toll in Russian strikes on Kremenchuk rises to four
items.teaser: As of 21:30, four people were known to have been injured in Russian strikes on the city of Kremenchuk.

items.title: Gedenktafel in Moskau - Putins Geheimdienst ehrt Stasi-Spionagechef Wolf
items.teaser: Russland würdigt die Spionage-Tätigkeiten des früheren DDR-Agenten mit einem Bronzerelief.

items.title: German government puts total aid to Ukraine since start of full-scale war at nearly EUR 101B
items.teaser: Since the start of Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine, Germany has provided or earmarked more than €43.3 billion in civilian aid and approximately €57.6 billion in military support for the coming years, bringing the total to around €100.9 billion.

items.title: Russian forces launch massive attack on Odesa region’s energy infrastructure
items.teaser: Russian forces launched a massive attack on energy infrastructure in the Odesa region, leaving part of the region without electricity.

items.title: Kalter Krieg: Die Geburtsstunde der modernen Geheimdienste
items.teaser: Im Kalten Krieg tummelten sich auch im Norden der DDR Agenten. In den 1950er-Jahren waren es zumeist einheimische Amateure.

items.title: Russian forces strike residential building, hotel in Kremenchuk
items.teaser: Russian forces launched drone strikes on Kremenchuk in the Poltava region, damaging a residential building and a hotel and sparking fires.

items.title: Video message of President António Costa for the New Economy Forum
items.teaser: President of the European Council António Costa delivered a video message on the occasion of the New Economy Forum award, in which he highlighted the important role of the 2026 awarded Ibero-American General Secretariat in promoting multilateralism and international relations.

items.title: Two rescuers injured in Russian drone attack on Komyshuvakha
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked State Emergency Service of Ukraine (SES) units three times with drones as they were working at the site of an airstrike in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region. Two rescuers were injured.

items.title: Ukraine war latest: Ukraine hits key bridge on 'highway of death' linking mainland Russia to occupied regions
items.teaser: Key developments on Nov. 7-8: Ukrainian drones hit key bridge, power stations in Russia's Rostov Oblast, governor says Europe to participate in Abu Dhabi peace talks, French foreign minister says Russian ballistic missiles slam Kyiv, damage Northern Bridge, injure at least 6 people Ukraine strikes Russian missile launc

items.title: Two killed, seven injured in Russian attacks on Dnipropetrovsk region
items.teaser: Two people were killed and seven others injured in Russian strikes across the Dnipropetrovsk region on November 8, with fatalities reported in the city of Dnipro and the Nikopol district.

items.title: Russian forces attack Kharkiv’s Kyivskyi district again, injuring one person
items.teaser: One person sustained blast injuries in a repeat attack on the Kyivskyi district of Kharkiv.

items.title: Ukrainian energy workers restore external power supply to ZNPP
items.teaser: Ukrainian energy workers have restored operation of the Ferosplavna-1 power line, which supplies external power to the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant (ZNPP).

items.title: Ukrainian drones hit key bridge, power stations in Russia's Rostov Oblast, governor says
items.teaser: Drone debris reportedly damaged the bridge over the Mius River, located on the R-280 highway — a strategic road that links Rostov Oblast with several Russian-occupied regions in Ukraine, including Crimea.

items.title: Citizens of six countries among victims of terrorist attack in Kraków
items.teaser: Citizens of six countries — Poland, the United Kingdom, Portugal, Russia, Germany and Austria — were killed or injured in Saturday's terrorist attack in central Kraków.

items.title: "We'll sit on a Swiss mountain and get sloshed": Rutte reveals how he and Zelenskyy plan to celebrate end of war
items.teaser: Mark Rutte has joked on Dutch television that he and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy plan to celebrate the end of the war together in the Swiss Alps.

items.title: Sybiha calls for boycott of Russia's participation in 2027 World Junior Ice Hockey Championship
items.teaser: International sports officials who make decisions on allowing Russians to return to international competitions have blood on their hands and become accomplices in Russian war crimes and efforts to cover them up.

items.title: Ukraine-Gespräche in Abu Dhabi: Europäer sind laut Frankreich "gut vertreten"
items.teaser: Ab Dienstag soll in Abu Dhabi über einen möglichen Frieden in der Ukraine verhandelt werden. Laut dem französischen Außenminister Barrot ist auch Europa vertreten: Frankreich werde an den Gesprächen mit den Russen teilnehmen.

items.title: Russia brings additional forces into Oleshky and surrounding community under cover of humanitarian operation – Zelensky
items.teaser: Russian troops brought additional forces into the temporarily occupied city of Oleshky and the surrounding community under the cover of a humanitarian operation. The Ukrainian Armed Forces Command is to submit proposals for providing additional protection to Kherson.

items.title: Zelensky tasks PM with creating free transportation program in Kyiv as Russia's bridge attacks hinder travel
items.teaser: According to the president's advisor, Dmytro Lytvyn, the plan's details could be presented as soon as tomorrow.

items.title: Zelensky instructs government to introduce free public transport programme in Kyiv
items.teaser: During a conference call, President Volodymyr Zelensky reviewed the progress of restoration work in the Dnipropetrovsk and Kharkiv regions. He also instructed the Prime Minister to present a programme providing free travel on the capital's surface public transport and ensuring an adequate reserve of buses for Kyiv.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Russia conducted major rotation of troops and equipment in Oleshky
items.teaser: President Zelenskyy has directed military leadership to bolster protection for Kherson residents following Russian troop reinforcements and energy strikes across multiple oblasts.

items.title: Traffic partially restored on Kyiv’s North Bridge
items.teaser: Traffic on Kyiv’s North Bridge is being partially restored on Sunday, November 8.

items.title: Anschlag in Magdeburg: Das Urteil steht, die Folgen bleiben
items.teaser: Ein Jahr nach dem Anschlag auf den Magdeburger Weihnachtsmarkt ist das Urteil noch nicht rechtskräftig, viele Betroffene leiden weiterhin.

items.title: 3 people, including child, die in Kyiv Oblast from improperly running generator as Russia slams power grids across Ukraine
items.teaser: The State Emergency Service said the victims died of carbon monoxide poisoning because they ran the generator in the basement instead of outside, at a safe distance. Another child in the home was hospitalized following the incident.

items.title: Barrot announces France's participation in trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi
items.teaser: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot has said that France will take part in the trilateral meeting between Ukraine, the United States and Russia expected to be held in Abu Dhabi, UAE, on November 10–11.

items.title: Russia cuts power to more than 600,000 in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast as Zelenskyy says the strikes aim to squeeze Ukraine before talks
items.teaser: Russia is hitting power and heat across Ukraine with winter weeks away, and Kyiv says Moscow treats diplomacy as one more way to attack.

items.title: The BBC has named 285,023 dead Russian soldiers. Russia’s own registry may hold up to 450,100 war dead, hackers say
items.teaser: The gap suggests how many deaths never make it into an obituary, a memorial, or a public grave.

items.title: Russian forces strike industrial facility in Poltava region
items.teaser: The Russian army attacked an industrial facility in Kremenchuk District, Poltava region, with a drone. According to preliminary information, no one was injured.

items.title: Schools in Zhytomyr to switch to remote learning following Russian strike
items.teaser: Repair crews work to restore heat in Zhytomyr while local schools shift to online learning and preschoolers are relocated following Russian drone strikes.

items.title: Why this South African decided to build a life in Ukraine — and document it
items.teaser: Kyiv-based South African tech entrepreneur and filmmaker Ronnie Apteker discusses Ukraine’s image abroad, persistent stereotypes, war fatigue, and the importance of telling stories that show Ukrainians as people building businesses, raising families, and creating despite the war.

items.title: Airstrike on underground school in Komyshuvakha: 29 of 55 victims identified
items.teaser: A total of 55 people are now known to have been killed in the strike on an underground school in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region. The identities of 29 victims have been established.

items.title: Europe to participate in Abu Dhabi peace talks, French foreign minister says
items.teaser: "The Europeans will be well represented, and France will be in Abu Dhabi to take part in these discussions. I cannot yet tell you who will represent France on this occasion, but it will certainly be there," French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot said.

items.title: Polen - Staatstrauer nach Anschlag mit Toten und Verletzten
items.teaser: In ​Polen hat nach dem Anschlag in Krakau mit sechs Toten eine zweitägige Staatstrauer begonnen. In der Stadt blieben der Marktplatz und die umliegenden Straßen ⁠weitgehend gesperrt.

items.title: Russland - Gedenktafel in Moskau erinnert jetzt an DDR-Spionagechef Markus Wolf
items.teaser: In Moskau ist eine Gedenktafel in Erinnerung an den früheren Chef der DDR-Auslandsspionage, Markus Wolf, enthüllt worden.

items.title: Serhii Sternenko: There are far bigger threats ahead of us than jet-powered Shahed drones
Russian attack in Khmelnytskyi region leaves two injured
items.teaser: Enemy drones attacked a residential building in Khmelnytskyi regin, and two people were hospitalised.

items.title: Forty-five people still missing following Russian strike on Komyshuvakha – photo
items.teaser: Drone attacks are hampering search and rescue operations in Zaporizhzhia Oblast as officials work to identify 55 bodies recovered from a destroyed humanitarian aid site.

items.title: The Way We Was (and How We Got Here): A Brief History of the Practice of Trade Law in the U.S.
items.teaser: It is funny but when we think of the top trade practitioners these days, instinctively we think of big law firms with a group of trade lawyers as one part of a larger practice. It has not always been like that.
items.source: Int. Economic Law and Policy Blog

items.title: Ukraine: Notstromabschaltungen in mehreren Regionen
items.teaser: Nach dem russischen Drohnen- und Raketenangriff wurden am Sonntag, dem 8. September, in mehreren Regionen der Ukraine Stromausfälle gemeldet.

items.title: Berlin says no more Patriots for now. Kyiv wants Russia’s missiles stopped before they leave the factory
items.teaser: Ukraine is pressing its partners to sync sanctions on the firms that build Russia’s ballistic missiles.

items.title: More than 800 km² liberated in Oleksandrivka sector this year thanks to Airborne Assault Forces – Zelensky
items.teaser: More than 800 square kilometres have been liberated in the Oleksandrivka sector this year thanks to the actions of the Airborne Assault Forces of the Armed Forces of Ukraine.

items.title: Defence Forces strike four enemy drone command posts in over past day
items.teaser: Over the past 24 hours, Ukraine's Defence Forces struck four enemy drone command posts in the temporarily occupied territories of Zaporizhzhia, Kherson and Donetsk regions, as well as on Russian territory.

items.title: Ukraine: AKW Saporischschja wieder vom Strom abgetrennt
items.teaser: Das von russischen Einheiten kontrollierte ukrainische Atomkraftwerk Saporischschja muss abermals mit Notstromaggregaten versorgt werden. Die Gründe hierfür sind noch nicht bekannt.

items.title: France to join Ukraine-US-Russia talks in Abu Dhabi
items.teaser: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot has confirmed that France will attend upcoming talks in Abu Dhabi to ensure European security interests are represented.

items.title: Russia to replace Norway in ice hockey championship as more countries vow to boycott games
items.teaser: In the new layout of the 2027 World Junior Hockey Championship, which is due to take place in Canada from Dec. 26, 2026, to Jan. 5, 2027, Russia will place tenth. As the lowest-ranked team, Norway will move down to Division 1A.

items.title: Russia was widening this bridge to four lanes for its Crimea road. Drones have now closed it
items.teaser: The construction cranes on the Mius crossing were hit too, Rostov’s governor said, leaving a key link to the occupied south out of use.

items.title: People injured and houses damaged in Russian attack on Khmelnytskyi Oblast
items.teaser: Firefighters extinguished a fire in Khmelnytskyi Oblast after Russian strikes damaged 12 homes and destroyed a house.

items.title: Ukraine’s 7th Air Assault Corps reports 20,000 Russian casualties in one year on Pokrovsk front
items.teaser: Units of the Ukrainian 7th Air Assault Corps killed or wounded more than 20,000 Russian troops in the Pokrovsk sector of the front in 2026.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike four drone ground control stations in Russia and occupied territories
items.teaser: Ukrainian defence forces hit four Russian drone ground control stations in Zaporizhzhia, Kherson, Donetsk oblasts and Russia's Bryansk Oblast on 7 November.

items.title: Russen melden Schäden an wichtiger Verbindungsbrücke bei Rostow
items.teaser: In der russischen Region Rostow ist bei einem Drohnenangriff eine Brücke über den Fluss Mius auf der Autobahn „Noworossija“ beschädigt worden.

items.title: Over 7,000 troops complete training under updated programs in Ukraine’s 7th Air Assault Corps
items.teaser: More than 7,000 service members of the 7th Air Assault Corps of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have undergone training under updated programs over the past year.

items.title: Security Service officers in regional offices told to chip in US$1,100-3,300 for senior official's bail – sources
items.teaser: Regional Security Service officers are required to contribute US$1,100-3,300 each towards the bail of General Serhii Duka, a Carthage case suspect.

items.title: Germany cannot supply Ukraine with more Patriot systems, Pistorius says
items.teaser: Germany is currently unable to provide Ukraine with additional Patriot air defense systems, as doing so would weaken Germany’s own defenses.

items.title: Russische Luftangriffe: Erneut Hunderttausende Ukrainer ohne Strom
items.teaser: Erneut hat Russland die ukrainische Energieversorgung schwer getroffen. In der Region Dnipropetrowsk haben 600.000 Menschen keinen Strom. Das besetzte Atomkraftwerk Saporischschja muss mit Notstromaggregaten gekühlt werden.

items.title: A regiment a day: Russia lost 16,130 troops in a week, its worst week of the war by Ukraine’s count
items.teaser: Ukraine’s military says Russian commanders keep sending infantry into frontal assaults, and the daily toll has broken records twice in two weeks.

items.title: Sandu warns of new Russian attempts to destabilize Moldova
items.teaser: Moldovan President Maia Sandu has said Russia will soon make new attempts to destabilize the situation in Moldova and create an impression of instability in the country.

items.title: Schütze hat "radikale Ansichten": Polen nennt Todesschüsse von Krakau Terror
items.teaser: Solch einen brutalen Anschlag hat Polen noch nie erlebt, sagt Ministerpräsident Tusk. In der Touristenmetropole Krakau erschießt ein Mann sechs Menschen. Ein Polizist ringt mit dem Tod. Das Motiv des Schützen ist noch unklar.

items.title: Ukraine’s 7th Air Assault Corps identifies its most in-demand military specialties
items.teaser: Units of the 7th Corps of the Ukrainian Air Assault Forces are most in need of personnel to fill combat positions, particularly riflemen, grenade launchers, machine gunners and designated marksmen.

items.title: Russen töten in Region Donezk fünf Zivilisten
items.teaser: Infolge des Beschusses der russischen Angreifer sind am 7. November fünf Menschen in der Region Donezk ums Leben gekommen.

items.title: Russian attack sets trucks and warehouses ablaze at transport company in Dnipro
items.teaser: Russian forces have again struck Dnipro, setting trucks and warehouses ablaze at a transport company.

items.title: Ukraine and Poland complete search work in Ternopil Oblast, no WWII mass graves found
items.teaser: Ukrainian and Polish experts finished a search phase at the former village of Puzhnyky in Ternopil Oblast, finding a chapel foundation but no mass grave.

items.title: Massive Stromausfälle nach russischen Angriffen auf Ukraine
items.teaser: Massive Stromausfälle nach russischen Angriffen auf Ukraine

items.title: Russia suffers record weekly losses of over 16,000 troops in early November – Ukraine’s General Staff
items.teaser: Russian forces lost 16,130 personnel in the first week of November, the highest weekly figure since the start of Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

items.title: One killed and three injured in Russian attack on Dnipro suburb – photos
items.teaser: A drone strike destroyed a house in a residential area. Two women and a man received medical assistance at the scene and declined hospitalisation.

items.title: Moscow police detain over 200 people, reportedly forcing some to sign military contracts
items.teaser: Detainees told the Russian Telegram channel "Ostorozhno, Novosti" that those over the age of 18 were "persistently" urged to sign a contract with Russia's Defense Ministry. Reports of police beating the detainees, smashing their phones, and prohibiting them from using the toilet later emerged.

items.title: Zelensky: Russia launches 115 missiles, nearly 1,900 guided bombs, over 3,000 drones at Ukraine in a week
items.teaser: Over the past week, Russia launched 115 missiles of various types, nearly 1,900 guided aerial bombs and more than 3,000 attack drones at Ukraine. If Ukraine cannot obtain anti-ballistic missiles from its partners, the EU needs to adopt a strong 22nd sanctions package.

items.title: Leiharbeiter: Nordkoreas Geldquelle in Russland
items.teaser: Nordkorea stellt nicht nur Soldaten für den Krieg gegen die Ukraine. In Russland sind auch Zehntausende Leiharbeiter tätig. Sie hoffen auf einen besseren Verdienst als in ihrer Heimat - erfüllt sich dieser Wunsch? Von Norbert Hahn.

items.title: Ukraine’s 7th Air Assault Corps expands APACHI Unmanned Systems Battalion
items.teaser: In 2026, the 7th Air Assault Corps of the Armed Forces of Ukraine significantly expanded the 237th Separate APACHI Unmanned Systems Battalion, which was established in late 2025.

items.title: Russian drone strike on Dnipro suburbs kills one person, injures another
items.teaser: Russian forces have struck the suburbs of Dnipro with a drone, sparking a fire.

items.title: Russia has attacked Ukraine with 115 missiles and over 3,000 drones this week, Zelenskyy reports – video
items.teaser: Zelenskyy says Russia has also launched nearly 1,900 guided aerial bombs; the president has called for stronger sanctions against companies involved in missile production.

items.title: Zuerst überflog ein US-Spionageflugzeug den strategisch wichtigen Suwalki-Korridor, dann umkreiste es die russische Exklave Kaliningrad
items.teaser: Ein US-Aufklärungsflugzeug hat erneut eine Mission nahe Kaliningrad geflogen. Die Artemis II überquerte dabei zweimal den Suwałki-Korridor.

items.title: Russischer Drohnenangriff auf Vorort von Dnipro: Ein Todesopfer
items.teaser: Die russische Armee hat mit einer Drohne einen Angriff auf einen Vorort von Dnipro geflogen.

The Max Planck Institute for Comparative Public Law and International Law is inviting submissions for a workshop to be held on 5 February 2027 on The Board of Peace and its role […]

items.title: Russians strike emergency workers at attack site in Komyshuvakha, Zelenskyy responds
items.teaser: No emergency workers were injured, but rescue equipment was damaged. Zelenskyy said search operations continue after a Russian airstrike killed 55 people.

items.title: Ukraine’s 7th Air Assault Corps carries out 8,000+ missions using ground robots in 2026
items.teaser: Units of the 7th Corps of the AFU Air Assault Forces completed more than 8,000 successful missions using ground robotic systems (GRS) in 2026.

items.title: Former teacher evacuated from Oleshky dies in Kyiv hospital
items.teaser: Former physical education teacher Olena Pyrozhenko, aged 56, has died in a Kyiv hospital after being evacuated from Oleshky. She had impaired motor functions.

items.title: Russian forces strike critical infrastructure facility in Cherkasy, power and heating disruptions possible
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked a critical infrastructure facility in Cherkasy, potentially causing disruptions to electricity and heating supplies.

items.title: Gedenktafel in Moskau: Russischer Geheimdienst würdigt DDR-Spionagechef Wolf
items.teaser: Im Westen ist der DDR-Chef für Auslandsspionage lange Zeit als der legendäre "Mann ohne Gesicht" bekannt. Das ist in Moskau anders: 20 Jahre nach seinem Tod erhält Markus Wolf in der russischen Hauptstadt eine Gedenktafel - dem heutigen russischen Auslandsgeheimdienst sei Dank.

items.title: Emergency power cuts introduced in Dnipro, Kyiv and five oblasts
items.teaser: Kyiv, Kharkiv, Sumy and Poltava oblasts and the cities of Kyiv and Dnipro are affected. Scheduled outage timetables do not apply during emergency cuts.

items.title: One injured and apartment block damaged in Russian drone attack on Kharkiv
items.teaser: One person was injured and the roof of an apartment block was damaged in a Russian drone attack on Kharkiv on the morning of Sunday 8 November.

items.title: Russian drones attack Volyn region overnight, fire breaks out at agricultural enterprise
items.teaser: A Russian drone attack on the Volyn region overnight sparked a fire at an agricultural enterprise in the Lutsk district. The fire has since been contained.

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages 199 Gefechte an der Front, Mehrheit davon Richtung Kostjantyniwka
items.teaser: Am 7. November kam es zu 199 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front.

items.title: First Oleshky evacuees discharged from hospital: what we know about the others
items.teaser: The first of several hundred evacuees from Oleshky have begun to be discharged from hospital. Since completing their treatment, they have gone to stay with family members and acquaintances. The rest are continuing to receive comprehensive support.

items.title: Turkish President Erdoğan discusses efforts to end war in Ukraine with Trump
items.teaser: The Turkish president expressed hope that intensified diplomacy will bring results and pledged Türkiye’s continued support for efforts involving both Kyiv and Moscow.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 7, injure 19 in Ukraine over the past day, striking Zaporizhzhia Oblast over 700 times
items.teaser: Russian forces carried out 725 strikes on 53 settlements in Zaporizhzhia Oblast alone, injuring one person, Governor Ivan Fedorov said.

items.title: ZNPP loses external power supply, switches to diesel generators
items.teaser: The Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant (ZNPP) has lost its external power supply and is operating on diesel generators.

items.title: Russia reports damage to bridge on highway connecting Rostov-on-Don with temporarily occupied Ukrainian territories
items.teaser: A bridge over the Mius River in Russia's Rostov region has been damaged in a drone attack. The bridge is located on the Novorossiya highway, which leads to Russian-occupied territories of Ukraine.

items.title: Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant experiences another blackout
items.teaser: The plant lost its last 330 kV power line at 02:36 on 8 November and is relying entirely on backup diesel generators, raising concerns over nuclear safety.

items.title: Luftabwehr neutralisiert 137 von 164 feindlichen Drohnen
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat 137 Kampfdrohnen unschädlich gemacht, mit denen Russland seit Abend dem 7. November das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hat.

items.title: War update: 199 combat engagements on front line over past day
items.teaser: A total of 199 combat engagements between the Ukrainian Defence Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Kostiantynivka front sees most Russian attacks over past day – Ukraine's General Staff
items.teaser: Ukraine’s General Staff reports 199 combat clashes over the past day, with the highest number of Russian assaults recorded on the Kostiantynivka front.

items.title: Russian forces kill five residents of Donetsk region over past day
items.teaser: Five people were killed in Russian shelling in the Donetsk region over the past day. Three died in Kramatorsk, while two others were killed in Bilenke and Druzhkivka.

items.title: Drone damages residential buildings in Khmelnytskyi, leaving one injured
items.teaser: Residential buildings in central Khmelnytskyi were damaged in an attack by an enemy drone. One person sustained injuries.

items.title: Trump's son-in-law Kushner seeks to revive NATO-Russia Council model as part of efforts to end war
items.teaser: Jared Kushner wants parallel talks on a Ukraine ceasefire and European security, but European officials insist a ceasefire must come before any new security framework.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,606,400 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 2,290 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Demokraten im US-Kongress bereiten Hilfspaket für Ukraine in Höhe von $15 Milliarden vor – FT
items.teaser: Nachdem die Demokraten bei den Wahlen die Kontrolle über beide Kammern des US-Kongresses erlangt haben, planen sie, die Unterstützung für die Ukraine zu verstärken und zusätzliche Sanktionen gegen Russland zu verhängen.

items.title: Russians kill five civilians in Donetsk Oblast over past day
items.teaser: Three people were killed in Kramatorsk and one each in Bilenke and Druzhkivka. Another five residents were injured on 7 November.

items.title: Russian forces attack industrial facility in Rivne region
items.teaser: A Russian overnight attack caused a fire at an industrial facility in the Sarny district of the Rivne region, destroying one of its buildings.

items.title: Verluste russischer Armee in Ukraine liegen binnen eines Tages bei 2290 weiteren Angreifern und vier Luftabwehrsystemen
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine liegen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 8. November 2026 bei rund 1.606.400 Soldaten. Binnen eines Tages wurden weitere 2.290 Besatzer getötet.

items.title: Temperatures to reach +10°C in Ukraine on Sunday, no precipitation expected
items.teaser: On Sunday, November 8, Ukraine will experience partly cloudy weather with no precipitation expected. Daytime temperatures will range from +1°C to +6°C, reaching up to +10°C in the Zakarpattia region.

items.title: Russia loses another 2,290 troops, four air defence systems in war in Ukraine over past day
items.teaser: Russia's total estimated combat losses since the beginning of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, from February 24, 2022, to November 8, 2026, amount to approximately 1,606,400 personnel, including 2,290 over the past 24 hours.

items.title: ADF neutralises 137 of 164 RUssian drones overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defence forces neutralised 137 of the 164 drones launched by Russian forces against Ukraine since the evening of November 7.

items.title: Ukrainian air defence downs 137 out of 164 Russian drones, including three-quarters of the jet-powered UAVs

items.title: Schwere Schäden nach Raketenangriffen auf Kiew
items.teaser: Russland hat kurz vor Wintereinbruch erneut die ukrainische Strom- und Wasserversorgung angegriffen. In einigen Teilen des Landes fiel der Strom aus. Präsident Selenskyj und Kiews Bürgermeister Klitschko streiten über die Verteidigung.

items.title: Military intelligence identifies Russian soldiers involved in deadly Komyshuvakha aid center strike
items.teaser: Four Russian Su-34 fighter-bombers were involved in the operation, according to Ukraine's military intelligence (HUR).

items.title: Russland: Putins Schattenkrieg – Jetzt muss Europa zurückschlagen
items.teaser: Russland führt einen verdeckten Krieg gegen Europa – mit Drohnen, Brandanschlägen und Sabotage. Europa hat die Gefahr erkannt, doch die bisherige Reaktion reicht nicht aus.

items.title: Emergency power cuts introduced in Kyiv region
items.teaser: Emergency power cuts have been introduced in the Kyiv region.

items.title: Russia attacks power transmission networks carrying electricity from nuclear power plants to Kyiv and central Ukraine
items.teaser: Russia attacked overnight the power transmission networks carrying electricity from nuclear power plants to Kyiv, the Kyiv region and central Ukraine.

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages 190 Gefechte an der Front, Mehrheit davon Richtung Kostjantyniwka
items.teaser: Am 6. November kam es zu 190 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front.

items.title: Russian forces shell Lozova, damaging apartment buildings, heating facility and kindergarten
items.teaser: Russian forces shelled the city of Lozova in the Kharkiv region in the morning, damaging apartment buildings, a heating facility and a kindergarten.

items.title: Russland setzt seine Angriffe auf ukrainische Energieanlagen und Brücken fort
items.teaser: Russland setzt seine Angriffe auf ukrainische Energieanlagen und Brücken fort

items.title: Partei-Verbindung zu Ibrahim Ibrahim - Linke-Kandidat war Anwalt von Terror-Unterstützer
items.teaser: Ahmed Abed vertrat Ibrahim Ibrahim vor Gericht, der vor der Wahl für ihn warb.

items.title: Russian forces attack Naftogaz facilities three times overnight
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked an oil and gas facility belonging to the Naftogaz Group, the largest national oil and gas company in Ukraine, in central Ukraine three times on the night of 6-7 November. The attack damaged equipment, caused an explosion at the site and sparked a large-scale fire.

items.title: Part of Brovary district in Kyiv region left without electricity following Russian attack
items.teaser: Part of Brovary district in the Kyiv region is without electricity following a Russian attack on a DTEK energy facility overnight.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 2, injure 37 across Ukraine over past day, hit substations connecting nuclear power plants to Kyiv
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Nov. 7 that substations were damaged in Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Kharkiv, and Dnipro oblasts.

items.title: Zelenskyy explains how ceasefire in Oleshky undermines Russia's arguments in negotiations
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that the experience of the ceasefire in Oleshky, Kherson Oblast, shows that a truce can be established quickly, without lengthy preparations, the withdrawal of weapons or the creation of buffer zones. In his view, the main obstacle remains Russian ruler Vladimir Putin's lack of politi

items.title: Russians strike Kharkiv with Bandерol drones, damaging houses, trolleybuses and cars
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked the Slobidskyi district of Kharkiv with Bandеrol drones, damaging residential buildings, cars and trolleybuses.

items.title: Defense Forces strike two Iskander launchers, Pantsir-S1 system in Russia's Bryansk region
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Forces struck two launchers of the Iskander operational-tactical missile system and a Pantsir-S1 air defense missile and gun system in Russia's Bryansk region.

items.title: Chernihiv and Slavutych partially without power following emergency outage
items.teaser: An emergency at a power supply facility left around 150,000 customers without electricity in the Koriukivka and Chernihiv districts, as well as in the cities of Chernihiv and Slavutych.

items.title: Russland greift Stromnetze an, die Kyjiw und die zentrale Region mit Strom aus Kernkraftwerken versorgen
items.teaser: Russland hat in der Nacht zum 7. November die Stromnetze angegriffen, über die Strom aus den Kernkraftwerken nach Kyjiw, in die Region Kyjiw und in die zentrale Region der Ukraine geliefert wird.

items.title: Russia attacks energy infrastructure in Vinnytsia Oblast, one person in critical condition
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked energy infrastructure facilities in Vinnytsia Oblast on the night of 6-7 November. One person has been injured and is in hospital in a critical condition. The attacks caused power supply disruptions across the oblast.

items.title: Zelensky: In addition to Kyiv, 12 regions of Ukraine come under attack overnight
items.teaser: In addition to Kyiv, 12 regions of Ukraine came under attack overnight.

items.title: Mehr Spielraum für BND und BfV: Schwarz-Rot einigt sich auf neue Befugnisse für Geheimdienste
items.teaser: Deutschlands Geheimdienste sollen künftig deutlich mehr dürfen. Von heimlichen Wohnungszutritten bis zur Sicherung von Telefon- und Internetdaten: Schwarz-Rot einigt sich auf eine Reform für BND und Verfassungsschutz. Doch für die Eingriffe bleiben Hürden.

items.title: Media: UK prepares for Zelenskyy's visit next year
items.teaser: The United Kingdom will host Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on a state visit next year.

items.title: Injury toll after Russian attack on Kyiv rises to six, including one child
items.teaser: The number of people injured in the Russian attack on Kyiv on November 7 has risen to six, including one child.

items.title: Generalstab: Ukrainische Truppen greifen mit „Neptun“-Raketen „Proton“-Werk in Orjol an
items.teaser: Die ukrainischen Raketeneinheiten haben mit Neptun-Raketen das Unternehmen Proton-Elektroteks in der Stadt Orjol getroffen.

items.title: General Staff: Ukrainian forces strike two Iskander launchers in Russia's Bryansk Oblast
items.teaser: Ukraine's defence forces struck two launchers of the Iskander operational-tactical missile system in Russia's Bryansk Oblast.

items.title: Ukraine: Russia hits Kyiv with airstrikes ahead of trilateral talks
items.teaser: The strikes hit a major bridge and energy facilities in the Kyiv region. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy accused Moscow of trying to "push" Ukraine "into a blackout" ahead of talks in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike Proton plant in Oryol with Neptune missiles – General Staff
items.teaser: Ukrainian missile forces struck the Proton-Electrotex plant in Oryol using Neptune missiles.

items.title: Man pulled from rubble in Kyiv Oblast dies after being rescued
items.teaser: A 66-year-old man has been killed in a large-scale Russian attack on Kyiv Oblast, while two other people have been injured. Residential buildings, energy facilities and civilian infrastructure have been damaged in five districts of the oblast.

items.title: KluwerArbitration ITA Arbitration Report, Volume No. XXIV, Issue No. 10 (September 2026)
items.teaser: The Institute of Transnational Arbitration (ITA), in collaboration with the ITA Board of Reporters , is happy to inform you that the latest ITA Arbitration Report was published: a free email subscription service available at KluwerArbitration.com delivering timely reports on awards, cases, legislation and current devel

items.title: Massive Russian attack: Energy facilities damaged in two districts of Kyiv region
items.teaser: Russian forces launched a massive attack on the Kyiv region using ballistic missiles and attack drones, targeting energy facilities, civilian infrastructure and residential buildings.

items.title: Russia attacks substations connecting Kyiv to nuclear power plants and infrastructure overnight – Zelenskyy
items.teaser: Russian forces launched a combined attack on Ukraine on the night of 6–7 November, using a total of 172 drones and 36 ballistic missiles. All the missiles were launched towards Kyiv and Kyiv Oblast, targeting energy facilities and infrastructure.

items.title: Luftabwehr neutralisiert vier feindliche Raketen und 149 Drohnen
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat vier feindliche Raketen und 149 Kampfdrohnen unschädlich gemacht, mit denen Russland seit Abend dem 6. November das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hat.

items.title: DIU identifies Russian military personnel involved in airstrike on Komyshuvakha
items.teaser: The Defense Intelligence od Ukraine (DIU) has identified Russian military personnel involved in an airstrike on Komyshuvakha in the Zaporizhzhia region.

items.title: Large-scale power outage hits Zhytomyr region after Russian strike on energy facility
items.teaser: A large-scale power outage has occurred in the Zhytomyr region following a Russian attack on energy infrastructure.

items.title: Ukraine strikes factory in Russia’s Oryol with Neptune missiles – General Staff
items.teaser: Ukrainian forces struck the Proton-Elektroteks military plant in Russia’s Oryol with Neptune missiles on 7 November, causing a fire and explosions at the facility.

items.title: Air defense downs four missiles, 149 drones used by Russia to attack Ukraine overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine’s air defense forces neutralized four missiles and 149 drones launched by Russian invaders in attacks on Ukraine since the evening of November 6.

items.title: Kyiv mayor shows damage to Pivnichnyi Bridge caused by Russian missiles – video
items.teaser: Several Russian missiles hit the bridge overnight, damaging its road surface, trolleybus overhead wires and a power line. Five lorries parked nearby were also damaged by the blast wave.

items.title: Saratov Oil Refinery on fire after drone attack in Russia – media
items.teaser: Drones attacked an oil refinery in the Russian city of Saratov overnight on November 7.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,604,110 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 2,280 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Verluste russischer Armee in Ukraine liegen binnen eines Tages bei 2280 weiteren Angreifern und drei Luftabwehrsystemen
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine liegen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 7. November 2026 bei rund 1.604.110 Soldaten. Binnen eines Tages wurden weitere 2.280 Besatzer getötet.

items.title: War update: 190 clashes on front line over past day, fiercest fighting in Kostiantynivka sector
items.teaser: A total of 190 combat engagements between the Ukrainian Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded on the front line on November 6.

items.title: Raketen treffen Nordbrücke in Kyjiw: Fahrbahn und Leitungen beschädigt
items.teaser: Mehrere Raketen trafen die Nordbrücke in Kyjiw und beschädigten die Fahrbahn, die Omnibuslinie und die Stromleitung.

items.title: Russia attacks Ukraine with 172 drones and missiles, with strikes and falling debris recorded at 34 locations
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defence intercepted four missiles and 149 drones, but strikes and falling debris were recorded at 34 locations across the country.

items.title: Kyiv facing extremely difficult energy situation after overnight Russian attack – Klitschko
items.teaser: Kyiv is facing an extremely difficult situation with its heating and water supply systems following a Russian overnight attack on energy facilities.

items.title: Bewegender Vortrag: Überlebende des 7. Oktobers in Hamburg
items.teaser: Sie verloren einen Freund und entkamen dem Terror: Im FC Sankt Pauli-Museum haben zwei junge Israelis ihre bewegende Geschichte erzählt.

items.title: Russischer Angriff beschädigt Nordbrücke – Verkehr in Hauptstadt komplett gesperrt
items.teaser: In der ukrainischen Hauptstadt Kyjiw wurde die Nordbrücke durch einen Angriff der Russischen Föderation beschädigt.

items.title: Death toll from Russian attack on Komyshuvakha rises to 55
items.teaser: Rescue workers have recovered the remains of nine more victims from under the rubble as search operations continue amid the threat of further Russian strikes.

items.title: Northern Bridge in Kyiv damaged in Russian attack
items.teaser: The Northern Bridge in Kyiv was damaged in a Russian attack.

items.title: Russian attacks on Sumy and Kherson oblasts: one killed and 17 injured
items.teaser: Drone strikes and guided aerial bomb attacks hit communities in Sumy and Kherson oblasts on 6 November, damaging houses and infrastructure.

items.title: Russia’s war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 2,280 over past day
items.teaser: Russia’s total combat losses in its full-scale invasion of Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to November 7, 2026, amount to approximately 1,604,110 personnel, including 2,280 over the past day.

items.title: Injury toll in Russian ballistic attack on Kyiv rises to five
items.teaser: Five people were injured in a Russian attack on Kyiv overnight on November 7.

items.title: Pivnichnyi Bridge in Kyiv damaged in overnight Russian attack, closed to traffic in both directions
items.teaser: Traffic has been suspended in both directions while workers assess the damage to the bridge following the overnight Russian strikes on Kyiv

items.title: Five people injured in Russian attack on Kyiv, including teenager – photos
items.teaser: Five people, including a teenager, have been injured in an overnight Russian attack on the Solomianskyi district of Kyiv. Fires broke out and several buildings were damaged.

items.title: Merz to discuss further support for Ukraine with Magyar
items.teaser: German Federal Chancellor Friedrich Merz will hold talks with Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar in Berlin on November 10, with further support for Ukraine among the topics on the agenda.

items.title: Kyiv faces extremely difficult situation with electricity, heating and water
items.teaser: Damage to energy infrastructure in Kyiv and Zhytomyr oblasts has affected the capital's utility services, with repair crews working to restore them.

items.title: Ground robotic systems complete record 31,398 logistics and evacuation missions in October
items.teaser: Ground robotic systems carried out 31,398 logistics and evacuation missions in October, surpassing the 30,000 mark for the first time.

items.title: Germany's Merz will discuss continued support for Ukraine with Hungarian PM
items.teaser: Friedrich Merz will host Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar in Berlin on 10 November for talks covering European affairs, defence and economic cooperation

items.title: Herbst: Putin wants peace talks, not peace
items.teaser: Putin agreed to trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi not to achieve peace, but to give the Trump administration an excuse to continue distancing itself from Kyiv.

items.title: Russia loses 2,280 soldiers and 44 artillery systems over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 2,280 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Russian ballistic attack injures three in Kyiv, including child
items.teaser: Three people were injured in a Russian missile strike on the capital, which damaged residential buildings and a kindergarten.

items.title: Trump says he has held phone calls on ending the war in Ukraine
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump says he has held phone calls and expects further discussions ahead of a meeting scheduled for Monday and Tuesday.

items.title: Russia's war against Ukraine unlikely to end with either side winning – Rutte
items.teaser: The war waged by Russia against Ukraine is unlikely to end with either side achieving victory.

items.title: Ukraine strikes Saratov Oil Refinery in mass attack on several Russian regions, reports say
items.teaser: Ukraine struck various sites in the Russian regions of Oryol, Saratov, and Rostov, hitting an oil refinery among several targets overnight on Nov. 7, monitoring channels reported.

items.title: Ukraine forecast to see temperatures from 5°C below zero to 7°C above zero this weekend, with light snow and icy roads
items.teaser: Ukraine is expected to experience light snowfall on Saturday, while no precipitation is forecast for Sunday. Nighttime temperatures will range from 2°C above zero to 5°C below zero, with daytime temperatures between 0°C and 7°C above zero.

items.title: Expert explains why Ukraine is exporting electricity despite power outages
items.teaser: Power outages in Ukraine are currently being driven not by a shortage of generating capacity but by damage to electricity transmission infrastructure.

items.title: AWOL serviceman detained in Odesa after threatening police officers with grenade
items.teaser: A 39-year-old serviceman who had allegedly gone absent without leave (AWOL) threatened police officers with a grenade inside a residential building on Semena Palii Street in Odesa.

items.title: Musk reposts tweet calling Starlink service for Ukraine 'mistake'
items.teaser: "In hindsight, it was a mistake for SpaceX to send (Ukraine) thousands of free Starlink dishes and millions of dollars a month in free service at the beginning of the war," the post reads.

items.title: Nature reserves under tank tracks: HUR details Russian destruction of Ukraine's environment
items.teaser: Russian troops have set up a mortar firing range on the territory of the Pryazovskyi National Nature Park.

items.title: Missiles strike Russia's Oryol, possibly targeting Proton plant – photos, video
items.teaser: Monitoring Telegram channels suggest the Proton plant may have been targeted and say that FP-5 Flamingo missiles were used. There has been no official confirmation.
